scientific_limitations: Counts isomorphism types of finite tree-closed subtrees in the unary-color expansion and grades by closure cardinality; does not count arbitrary finite subsets, uniform finite approximants, or uncolored types.
In the nested-infinity case the lower bound is stretched exponential and the upper bound subexponential, not a sharp full asymptotic.
Finite tests check bounded examples only; the all-plan theorem uses the included proof.
Independent mathematical review and novelty certification have not been performed.
title: Polynomial–intermediate dichotomy for finite tree-closures in tree-plan generics
